meta.title: Features — Everstead
meta.description: Explore everything Everstead offers — document scanning, AI-assisted instructions, personal messages, trusted contacts, and a readiness score to keep your plan on track.

hero.title: Everything your family needs to find — all in one place.
hero.subtitle: Everstead gives you a structured, secure, and complete picture of your estate — accounts, documents, instructions, and final wishes — organised and accessible to the right people when it matters most.

problem.eyebrow: What families face without a plan

core.title: Ten features. One complete plan.
core.subtitle: Each feature is designed around the questions families actually ask after a loss — and the answers they struggle to find.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.headline: The story only you can tell — kept for the people you love.
aboutMe.body: More than accounts and admin. The music you'd want played, a letter to your children, the life events that shaped you, a playlist that's unmistakably yours. It's the warm, human heart of your plan — written on your own terms and shared only with the people you choose, either now or when your plan is one day activated.
bullets: Life events, passions, and personal reflections
Letters and messages for the people you love
A profile photo and a playlist that capture who you are
Shared only with chosen people — never with solicitors or advisers

aiAssistant.title: Your AI Assistant
aiAssistant.headline: A private helper, for when admin feels like too much.
aiAssistant.body: If getting this sorted has ever felt overwhelming, you don't have to do it alone. Your AI Assistant is a calm, private helper inside your account — chat in plain English, or simply drop in a document and it will read it and suggest entries for you. It works one small step at a time, and nothing is ever saved until you review and confirm it. It can also answer practical questions about how Everstead works.
bullets: Chat, or drop in a document — it suggests entries for you to review
Nothing is saved until you confirm — it suggests, you decide
Helps you begin even when the words, or the energy, don't come easily
Private to your account; switch AI off any time in Settings

accounts.title: Account Inventory
accounts.headline: Every account, documented once and found instantly.
accounts.body: Bank accounts, investments, pensions, ISAs, crypto wallets, insurance policies, utility providers, subscriptions — all structured, labelled, and searchable. Add institution names, account numbers, login hints, and contacts so nothing is buried or forgotten.
bullets: Banking, investment, pension & insurance accounts
Digital assets, crypto, and online accounts
Subscription tracker with renewal dates and costs
Custom categories and tags

documents.title: Secure Document Vault
documents.headline: Legal and personal documents, stored and shared safely.
documents.body: Upload your will, power of attorney, property deeds, passport, birth certificate, insurance policies, and more. Tag by category, assign access by role, and keep a version history so nothing gets overwritten without a trace.
bullets: Wills, LPAs, deeds, insurance policies
Encrypted at rest with AES-256
Role-based access — share only what is needed
Version history and file audit log
documents.ai: Upload a document — we extract the key details automatically. ✨

instructions.title: Step-by-Step Instructions
instructions.headline: Written guidance exactly when it is needed most.
instructions.body: Tell your family what to do, in what order, and who to call — in plain language. Cover the first 48 hours, estate administration, account closure, and anything personal. Your words, preserved and delivered with clarity.
bullets: First-steps guidance for the days after death
Account closure and estate admin checklists
Contact lists with names, roles, and numbers
Personal notes and situation-specific guidance
instructions.ai: Not sure what to write? We'll help you find the words. ✨

people.title: Trusted People & Roles
people.headline: The right people see the right information — nothing more.
people.body: Assign roles like executor, spouse, child, solicitor, or financial adviser. Each role gets access only to what you've explicitly shared. You can adjust, revoke, or expand access at any time — staying in full control.
bullets: Named roles: executor, spouse, adviser, caregiver
Granular per-section access control
Revoke or update access at any time
Access notification when a trusted person views

access.title: Emergency Vault & Sharing
access.headline: Instant access when there is no time to spare.
access.body: Set up your Emergency Vault to unlock automatically under specific conditions — or grant a trusted person a one-tap access request. Every access event is logged in a full audit trail so nothing happens without a record.
bullets: Emergency vault with controlled unlock conditions
One-tap access request for trusted people
Time-locked or condition-based sharing
Complete audit trail of every access event

wishes.title: Final Wishes
wishes.headline: Personal preferences captured with dignity.
wishes.body: Record funeral and memorial preferences, organ donation wishes, personal letters, sentimental item instructions, and burial or cremation details. Everstead ensures these are found, read, and honoured.
bullets: Funeral and memorial service preferences
Organ and tissue donation wishes
Personal letters and messages for loved ones
Allocation of sentimental or personal items
wishes.ai: We can help you start when the words don't come easily. ✨

messages.title: Personal Messages
messages.headline: Your words, delivered when it matters most.
messages.body: Write a personal note or record a video message for anyone in your plan — your spouse, children, solicitor, or a close friend. Each message is sealed, encrypted, and released only to the named recipient when your delegates access the plan. Say what you need to say, on your own terms.
bullets: Written notes for named individuals — personal and private
Video messages recorded and stored securely in-platform
Released only to the intended recipient after the plan is activated
Separate messages per person — different words for different relationships
messages.ai: Write it yourself or let us help you get started. ✨

subscriptions.title: Subscription Tracker
subscriptions.headline: Stop paying for things that outlive the person who signed up.
subscriptions.body: List every recurring charge — streaming services, software, memberships, gym contracts, magazines. Add amounts, renewal dates, and cancellation instructions. Executors can action each line without guesswork or surprise charges.
bullets: All recurring charges in one view
Renewal dates and billing amounts
Cancellation instructions per service
Prevents active subscriptions running undetected

progress.title: Readiness Score
progress.headline: Know exactly how complete your plan is.
progress.body: The readiness score tracks completeness across all sections — accounts, documents, instructions, trusted people, and final wishes. Smart prompts surface what's missing, so your plan stays current and nothing falls through the gaps.
bullets: Completeness score across all plan sections
Smart prompts for missing or outdated items
Periodic review reminders
A clear signal your family can rely on you've prepared
progress.ai: Your AI readiness coach tells you exactly what to focus on next. ✨

security.title: Built for privacy, trust, and control.
security.subtitle: Your data is never sold, never shared without permission, and always encrypted. We built Everstead for families — not advertisers.

points.label: AES-256 encrypted storage
points.desc: Military-grade encryption for all data, at rest and in transit.

points.label: Role-based access controls
points.desc: Each trusted person sees only their assigned sections.

points.label: Full audit log
points.desc: Every view, share, and change is permanently recorded.

points.label: Privacy-first by design
points.desc: No data selling, no advertising, no third-party access without consent.

points.label: Access notifications
points.desc: You are notified whenever a trusted person accesses your plan.

points.label: Secure backups
points.desc: Encrypted, redundant backups ensure your plan is never lost.

who.title: Everstead works for everyone in a family plan.

items.title: Families
items.desc: One place where every household member knows accounts, documents, and wishes are recorded — so no one is left guessing.

items.title: Executors
items.desc: A complete, structured guide to the estate — accounts, contacts, documents, and instructions — without weeks of searching.

items.title: Aging Adults
items.desc: Build a plan at your own pace, assign trusted people, and know that your wishes and affairs are properly documented.

items.title: Estate Advisers
items.desc: Offer clients a secure, organised estate record they can maintain themselves — and that dramatically reduces your administration burden.

comparison.title: Better than a spreadsheet. More accessible than a solicitor.
comparison.subtitle: Spreadsheets get lost. Solicitors hold documents you can't access yourself. Everstead gives families a living, secure, accessible plan.
rows: Always up to date, editable any time

readiness.title: A clear measure of how prepared your family is.
readiness.body: The readiness score tracks your plan across every section. Smart prompts tell you what's missing, outdated, or needs a second look — so you can always answer "yes, everything is in order."
bullets: Tracks completeness across all sections
Highlights missing or outdated items
Periodic review reminders
Peace of mind, measurable

legal.title: Everstead is not a legal service and does not replace professional advice.
legal.body1: Everstead is an organisation and planning platform. It helps you store references to documents, record instructions, and share access with trusted people. It does
legal.body2: draft wills, prepare legal instruments, give legal or financial advice, or replace a solicitor, estate lawyer, accountant, or family adviser. If you need legal or financial guidance, please consult a qualified professional.
